say:1:1631839001:1.text: There's this one guy who keeps asking me for directions.
say:1:1631839001:1.source_cn: 我总是能碰见一个问路的幽灵。
say:1:1631839001:1.male: There's this one guy who keeps asking me for directions.
say:1:1631839001:1.female: There's this one guy who keeps asking me for directions.

say:2:1631839002:1.text: I tell him where to go, he thanks me, then five minutes later he's lost again.
say:2:1631839002:1.source_cn: 我每次给他指过路以后，下次他还是会忘记该怎么走。
say:2:1631839002:1.male: I tell him where to go, he thanks me, then five minutes later he's lost again.
say:2:1631839002:1.female: I tell him where to go, he thanks me, then five minutes later he's lost again.

say:3:1631839003:1.text: So I figured I'd just make signs and save myself the trouble.
say:3:1631839003:1.source_cn: 我就想干脆做一些指示牌，省得他每次都问我。
say:3:1631839003:1.male: So I figured I'd just make signs and save myself the trouble.
say:3:1631839003:1.female: So I figured I'd just make signs and save myself the trouble.

choice_prompt:4:1631839003.text: So I figured I'd just make signs and save myself the trouble.
choice_prompt:4:1631839003.source_cn: 我就想干脆做一些指示牌，省得他每次都问我。
choice_prompt:4:1631839003.male: So I figured I'd just make signs and save myself the trouble.
choice_prompt:4:1631839003.female: So I figured I'd just make signs and save myself the trouble.

say:5:1631839004:1.text: Problem is, this forest already has enough creepy rumors going around.
say:5:1631839004:1.source_cn: 这片森林里奇怪的传说已经够多了。
say:5:1631839004:1.male: Problem is, this forest already has enough creepy rumors going around.
say:5:1631839004:1.female: Problem is, this forest already has enough creepy rumors going around.

say:6:1631839005:1.text: I don't want people adding "haunted signposts" to the list.
say:6:1631839005:1.source_cn: 我可不希望再多一个幽灵指示牌的传说。
say:6:1631839005:1.male: I don't want people adding "haunted signposts" to the list.
say:6:1631839005:1.female: I don't want people adding "haunted signposts" to the list.

say:7:1631839006:1.text: It's finally quiet out here. And I'd really like to keep it that way.
say:7:1631839006:1.source_cn: 我很满意现在的清静，我可不希望招惹更多的人过来。
say:7:1631839006:1.male: It's finally quiet out here. And I'd really like to keep it that way.
say:7:1631839006:1.female: It's finally quiet out here. And I'd really like to keep it that way.

choice:4:0:1.text: Why only let ghosts see it?
choice:4:0:1.source_cn: 为什么只希望幽灵看见
choice:4:0:1.male: Why only let ghosts see it?
choice:4:0:1.female: Why only let ghosts see it?
